overview_description.description: Untap is a competition management platform used by organizations to easily plan, launch, manage, and assess online competitions. It streamlines the entire process of receiving and managing submissions, engaging with applicants and judges, evaluating entries, running multiple rounds of submissions, and generating an in-depth analysis. Untap enables companies, grant providers, universities, educational institutions, and accelerators to tap into the power of open innovation.

about_short_description.short_description: A competition management platform that enables innovation-driven organizations to plan, launch, manage, and assess open innovation programs.

product.name: Untap Compete
product.description: A cloud-based submission management platform for planning, launching, and managing competitions and calls for applications with customizable websites, submission forms, and evaluation workflows.

product.name: Awards Management Platform
product.description: Software to manage award programs including applicant tracking, judging, public voting, and analytics with customizable websites and workflows.

product.name: Creative Contests Platform
product.description: A platform to manage creative contests for artists, designers, filmmakers, and other creatives with multi-round submissions, judging, and public engagement features.

product.name: Grants Management Platform
product.description: A solution to streamline grant application collection, management, multi-phase evaluation, and reporting with customizable forms and analytics.

product.name: Innovation Challenges Platform
product.description: A platform to run open innovation challenges with customizable landing pages, multi-round submissions, mentorship, and evaluation workflows.

product.name: Online Hackathons Platform
product.description: A platform to manage online hackathons including registration, multi-round submissions, mentorship scheduling, judging, team formation, and certificate generation.
